title: Prayer
description: Prayer is simply talking with God — praising him, saying thank you, admitting where we've gone wrong, and asking for what we need.

waypoints.title: Talking With God
waypoints.body: Prayer isn't a formula -- it's a conversation. Jesus taught his followers exactly how to pray when they asked him, giving a simple pattern anyone can follow.

waypoints.title: One Sentence Each
waypoints.body: As a family, take turns each praying one sentence out loud tonight -- one thank you, one sorry, one please.
